name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Financial assistance to OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
benefits: Maintenance allowance for hostellers and day scholars
Reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory fees
Study tour allowance and thesis typing/printing charges
documents: Academic Mark Sheet of last qualifying examination
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
source_name: National Scholarship Portal, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Centrally sponsored scheme offering financial aid to Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-secondary courses in recognized institutions.
benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement
Monthly maintenance allowance
Additional disability allowance where applicable
source_name: National Scholarship Portal, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)
description: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000
Direct benefit transfer directly into verified bank accounts
documents: Active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Mission to provide all-weather pucca houses to eligible urban beneficiaries including EWS, LIG, and MIG families.
benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans
Financial assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for new house construction
documents: Proof of no existing pucca house in India
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Rural housing scheme aiming to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to houseless and kutcha house dwellers in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas
MGNREGA wage support of 90/95 days for house construction
₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate employment opportunities through micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors.
benefits: Margin money subsidy up to 35% of project cost for special categories / rural areas
Bank loan up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing units and ₹20 lakh for service units
documents: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th pass minimum for projects > ₹10 lakh)
source_name: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Scheme to provide collateral-free micro-loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Shishu Loan: Loans up to ₹50,000
Kishor Loan: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 Lakh
Tarun Loan: Loans above ₹5 Lakh and up to ₹10 Lakh
Zero collateral requirement
documents: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
source_name: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health coverage to vulnerable and low-income families.
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year
Covers secondary and tertiary hospitalisation across empanelled public & private hospitals
Pre and post-hospitalisation expenses covered

name: PM Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Scheme
description: Single-window portal providing access to education loans and interest subsidy schemes for students pursuing higher studies.
benefits: Single application platform for education loan across 40+ banks
Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) during moratorium period for income up to ₹4.5 Lakh
documents: Aadhaar Card of student and co-borrower

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
description: Scheme facilitating bank loans to SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield micro/small enterprises.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore for manufacturing, services or trading sector
RuPay debit card provided for drawing working capital
Handholding support and credit guarantee cover
source_name: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Skill certification scheme encouraging youth to take up industry-relevant skill training for better livelihood opportunities.
benefits: Free short-term skill training in emerging domains (AI, Robotics, Industry 4.0, Soft skills)
NSDC Recognized skill certificate
Placement assistance and financial stipend during training
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
description: Maharashtra state scholarship scheme offering tuition fee reimbursement to economically weaker students in higher professional courses.
benefits: 50% reimbursement of total tuition fees and examination fees for professional diploma/degree courses
documents: Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar (up to ₹8 Lakh)
source_name: Government of Maharashtra Higher & Technical Education Department

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
description: Special micro-credit facility empowering urban street vendors to resume work and expand micro businesses post pandemic.
benefits: Initial collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000
Second trimester loan up to ₹20,000 and third loan up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment
7% interest subsidy per annum and monthly cashback on digital payments
documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Comprehensive credit delivery system for farmers to meet short-term credit requirements for cultivation of crops and post-harvest expenses.
benefits: Revolving credit up to ₹3 lakh at subsidized 4% effective interest rate (with prompt repayment incentive)
Atm-enabled KCC RuPay card for flexible drawals
Personal Accident Insurance and Crop Insurance cover included
documents: No-dues certificate from nearby bank branches
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / NABARD

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive central scheme offering holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftsmen engaged in 18 traditional trades.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Digital ID and Certificate
Basic & Advanced Skill Training with ₹500/day stipend
₹15,000 e-voucher toolkit incentive
Collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakh (₹1L first tranche + ₹2L second tranche) at subsidized 5% interest
source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Scheme promoting apprenticeship training and incentives to employers for engaging apprentices in industrial organizations.
benefits: 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice reimbursed by Govt
Practical hands-on industry experience and NCVT Certificate
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
